stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.take: Another $11 billion, at a $1.25 trillion valuation, in a round that has not closed yet — the AI money machine is not slowing down.

stories.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
stories.take: Google is taking over Crusoe's troubled Wyoming build — a clean illustration of how hard massive AI data centers are to actually deliver.

stories.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
stories.take: Usage keeps climbing but spending has stalled as big buyers cut prices and tighten controls — awkward timing with Anthropic heading to an IPO.

stories.title: Free Chinese AI Models Are Getting Scary Good at Hacking
stories.take: In simulated network break-ins, DeepSeek and GLM landed not far behind OpenAI's best cyber model — and they are free.

stories.title: Chainalysis says hackers stole credentials and tokens for all of its customers
stories.take: A 'multifront cyberattack' — including AI agents and an on-path snatch — took credentials and tokens for every Chainalysis customer.

stories.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
stories.take: It is official: the Cybertruck winds down in 2027 after underwhelming sales, and the factory space goes to Cybercabs.

stories.title: The AI backlash needs a plan
stories.take: Democrats now have a mandate to rein in frontier labs and data centers — the question is whether they can do it without repeating the social-media era's mistakes.

stories.title: FAA to finally ditch floppy disks in what it calls "historic" tech upgrade
stories.take: Floppy-free by the end of 2028 at 435 sites: the FAA is finally retiring the disks from its information display systems.

stories.title: Fox Corp. Completes $22 Billion Deal for Roku
stories.take: The $22 billion deal is done: Roku folds into Fox Digital Platforms alongside Tubi, Fox One and Red Seat Ventures.

stories.title: Pastor Talarico, 3 Billion Views, and $56 Million on Broadcast: How James Talarico’s Team Flipped Texas
stories.take: 3 billion views plus $56 million on broadcast: Talarico's creative director and paid-media strategist explain how viral clips became a historic Texas win.

stories.title: Political Campaigns Spent a Near-Record $331 Per Voter, But Waste Forces Rethink
stories.take: Near-record $331 per voter — and the GOP's spending advantage did not translate into votes, forcing a strategic rethink.

stories.title: Amazon’s shopping agent now takes orders by text, with Sponsored Product ads in the replies
stories.take: You can now text Amazon's shopping agent to place an order — and the thread that takes your order will carry Sponsored Product ads.

stories.title: e.l.f.’s stop-motion Christmas ad is a win for human creativity
stories.take: Handcrafted stop-motion over AI gloss: e.l.f.'s Christmas film is a deliberate, intricate win for human creativity.

stories.title: Maxon aims to make 3D creation feel more natural with ZBrush and Cinema4D for the PROLED XDR MacBook and Apple Vision pro
stories.take: Touch sculpting and Spatial Preview bring ZBrush and Cinema 4D onto the new MacBook and Vision Pro in a more natural way to work.

stories.title: Creators see promise in Instagram’s long-form push, but question whether exposure is enough
stories.take: Instagram wants YouTube's long-form creators — creators like the reach, but exposure alone may not pay the bills.

stories.title: Warriors' Porzingis to 'step away' from NBA to prioritize his health
stories.take: Kristaps Porzingis is stepping away from the Warriors to prioritize his health — he has not played this season on his two-year, $40 million deal.

stories.title: Rivers: Giannis was playing games when trying to leave Bucks
stories.take: Doc Rivers says Giannis 'didn't want to be the bad guy' while pushing for a Bucks exit last season — it was a game, not a direct trade demand.

stories.title: Lakers send little-used Bronny James to G League affiliate
stories.take: 12 minutes across five appearances in year three: the 7-2 Lakers have sent Bronny James to their G League affiliate in Coachella Valley.

stories.title: Wemby draws MVP chants with career performance, predicts more to come
stories.take: Career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds plus eight blocks against Dallas — Wembanyama is drawing MVP chants and says more is coming.

stories.title: Cancelled? Knicks' Kolek, McBride call out Taylor Swift as 'performative' fan
stories.take: Two Knicks called Taylor Swift a performative fan; the team promptly defended her as a longtime, appreciated supporter.

stories.title: Ex-NBA player Davis to plead guilty in federal sports betting case
stories.take: Former NBA player Ed Davis is expected to plead guilty in his federal sports betting case, per a court docket entry filed Friday.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Tarik Skubal's market already hot, contenders eyeing Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato
stories.take: The hot stove is lit: Skubal's market is already hot, and contenders are circling Japanese slugger Teruaki Sato.

stories.title: Witness: Clase 'inside' pitch info dried up amid Mizuhara case fallout
stories.take: In the Clase–Ortiz pitch-rigging trial, a witness says the inside pitch info dried up once the Ohtani interpreter scandal brought scrutiny.

stories.title: Pujols to interview for Astros' managerial opening, sources say
stories.take: Albert Pujols is expected to interview for Houston's managerial vacancy — a future Hall of Famer testing the dugout.

stories.title: D-backs' Carroll has elbow surgery, expected to be ready for spring training
stories.take: Corbin Carroll had right elbow surgery this week and is expected back for spring training in February.

stories.title: Guide to MLB's labor battle: Will there be a lockout? A salary cap?
stories.take: With Dec. 1 approaching and a new CBA proposal on the table, the lockout and salary-cap questions now frame the whole offseason.

stories.title: US carries out another round of ‘minor’ strikes on Iran, Trump says
stories.take: Trump says the US carried out another round of limited strikes on Iran on Friday, even as diplomatic efforts to end the conflict accelerate.

stories.title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
stories.take: After sweeping midterm losses, Trump replaces Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller — the hardline architect of his immigration agenda takes the chief of staff job.

stories.title: What to know about a better-than-expected jobs report amid AI bubble concerns
stories.take: Employers added 165,000 jobs in October, with August and September revised up by a combined 84,000 — a sturdier labor market than expected.

stories.title: News Wrap: Judge blocks construction of Trump's triumphal arch for now
stories.take: A judge has put Trump's massive triumphal arch near Arlington on hold for now, in a Friday wrap that also saw two more top Justice Department officials resign.

stories.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
stories.take: The first Native American woman, the first Muslim senator, and the Senate's first Paralympian — Tuesday's class is full of historic firsts.

stories.title: Democrats win the Arizona House, Senate and governor's office for the first time since 1966
stories.take: Both Arizona chambers flipped Friday, confirming a Democratic trifecta in the state for the first time since 1966.

stories.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
stories.take: Hyde-Smith vs. Colom is razor-thin, and Mississippi's slow, decentralized count means no one knows how many ballots are still out.

stories.title: WATCH: 'Elections matter.' Houston mayor limits police cooperation with ICE
stories.take: Houston is limiting police cooperation with ICE — one of the first such moves since Democrats' midterm rout.

stories.title: With death sentence clemency, Newsom takes another big political risk
stories.take: Newsom's mass commutation of death sentences pushes his authority — and his 2028 prospects — into a clear national statement.

stories.title: Vincent Thomas Bridge closes for 16 months on Saturday. Here's what you need to know
stories.take: The Vincent Thomas Bridge shuts Saturday for 16 months — routes and timeline for navigating the closure are inside.

stories.title: Feds move to dismiss case over 20,000 California ballots after Supreme Court denied appeal
stories.take: After the Supreme Court rejected the emergency request, the feds are dropping the case over 20,000 California ballots.

stories.title: Barri Worth Girvan declares victory in race for West Valley seat on L.A. City Council
stories.take: Barri Worth Girvan declared victory for L.A. Council District 3 after Friday evening's tallies.

stories.title: California says 6,500 homes near shuttered Exide plant are 'clean.' But soil samples raise questions
stories.take: The state calls 6,500 homes near the shuttered Exide lead plant clean — fresh soil samples raise questions about that call.

stories.title: Southwest flight from Orange County declares emergency, lands at LAX
stories.take: A Southwest flight from John Wayne to San José declared a general emergency Friday afternoon and landed at LAX.

stories.title: California’s new teen social media law challenged in court by Meta, TikTok and Google
stories.take: California's ban on addictive features for kids takes effect in January — Meta, TikTok and Google are suing in federal court to stop it.

stories.title: Companies Are Spending 5x More on AI Now
stories.take: The answer: average enterprise AI spend is up 4.7x vs 2025 — total spend hit almost $177B in 2026, up from $33B in 2025, and companies spent ~2.5x what they budgeted • Agents caused it: spend shifted from per-seat to per-token, scaling with work, not headcount • Anthropic takes 55% of API spend vs OpenAI's 31%; frontier models rose to 63% of model spend • Coding dominates: Codex + Claude Code revenue jumped $1B → $24B in a year

stories.title: An optimistic October jobs report
stories.take: October jobs blew past forecasts: 165,000 added vs ~65,000 expected, unemployment down to 4.1% • White-collar hiring surged — consultants and tech roles to help companies implement AI • Foreign ownership of US government debt has fallen from ~60% in 2008 to 25%, pushing up borrowing costs for everyone • With mortgage rates at 7.18%, friends are co-buying homes — nearly 1 in 3 sales this year by one report

stories.title: Providing Capital to Tech Companies: Masters In Business with Ann Berry
stories.take: Ann Berry (Threadneedle) pairs capital with operational help — her edge is execution, not financial engineering • Cash discipline: even very early-stage companies should show free cash flow within about two years • Running hotel-laundry PureStar through COVID taught her to listen to front-line operators, not just the C-suite • On AI: she backed Yann LeCun's world-models company AMI, and flags incumbents sitting on data — Walmart turned its data into a ~$6.5B ad business

stories.title: Elon Musk Says Good-Bye to Tesla’s Cybertruck… and Hello to Texas Democrats
stories.take: October jobs beat big: 165,000 added, unemployment 4.1%, prior months revised up 84,000 • Trump names Stephen Miller chief of staff after midterm losses; Elizabeth Warren is set to lead Senate Banking • Tesla winds down the Cybertruck for Cybercab production — polarizing design, weak EV-truck demand, and Musk's politics sank it • Texas Democrats say the 'rubber stamp era' for Musk is over, but on Texas's terms, not an exit
